grammarFocus: 一般过去时；规则与常用不规则过去式；then / after that / finally。
title: A Day Trip to the Beach
instructions: 这是一份模拟听力练习，适合A2水平学习者，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答问题。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误（True/False/Not Given）。填空答案必须使用原文中的词，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文。
transcript: Last Saturday, my family and I went to the beach. We left home at eight o'clock in the morning. First, we drove to the beach. The drive took about one hour. After that, we parked the car and walked to the sand. The weather was sunny and hot. We put our things on the sand and went swimming. The water was cool and clean. Then we had a picnic lunch. I ate a sandwich and my sister ate a salad. After that, we played volleyball on the beach. My father took many photos. Finally, we watched the sunset. It was beautiful. We left the beach at six o'clock in the evening. On the way home, we stopped at a small restaurant. We ate dinner there. I had fish and my mother had chicken. The food was delicious. We arrived home at nine o'clock. We were very tired but happy. It was a great day. Next time, we want to visit a museum. My brother said, 'Let's go to the mountains next time.' But I said, 'No, I want to go to the museum.' So we will decide later. My sister wants to go to the zoo. We will see. Anyway, we had a wonderful time at the beach.

options: At eight o'clock in the morning
At nine o'clock in the morning
At six o'clock in the evening
answers: At eight o'clock in the morning
questions.explanation: 原文提到“We left home at eight o'clock in the morning.”，所以是早上八点离开家。
questions.evidence: We left home at eight o'clock in the morning.

questions.prompt: How did they go to the beach?
questions.explanation: 原文说“First, we drove to the beach.”，drove是drive的过去式，表示开车去，所以是坐汽车。
questions.evidence: First, we drove to the beach.

questions.prompt: How long did the drive take? (Use two words.)
questions.explanation: 原文提到“The drive took about one hour.”，所以开车大约花了一小时。
questions.evidence: The drive took about one hour.

questions.explanation: 原文说“The weather was sunny and hot.”，所以天气晴朗炎热。
questions.evidence: The weather was sunny and hot.

questions.prompt: What did they do after swimming?
questions.explanation: 原文提到“Then we had a picnic lunch.”，所以游泳后他们吃了野餐午餐。
questions.evidence: Then we had a picnic lunch.

questions.prompt: What did the speaker eat for lunch? (Use one word.)
questions.explanation: 原文说“I ate a sandwich and my sister ate a salad.”，所以说话者午餐吃了三明治。
questions.evidence: I ate a sandwich and my sister ate a salad.

questions.prompt: What did they do after lunch?
questions.explanation: 原文提到“After that, we played volleyball on the beach.”，所以午餐后他们打了排球。
questions.evidence: After that, we played volleyball on the beach.

questions.prompt: What did they watch before leaving the beach?
questions.explanation: 原文说“Finally, we watched the sunset.”，所以离开海滩前他们看了日落。

questions.prompt: What did the speaker eat for dinner?
questions.explanation: 原文提到“I had fish and my mother had chicken.”，所以说话者晚餐吃了鱼。
questions.evidence: I had fish and my mother had chicken.

questions.prompt: They arrived home at nine o'clock in the evening.
questions.explanation: 原文明确提到“We arrived home at nine o'clock.”，所以他们在晚上九点到家，与题目一致。
questions.evidence: We arrived home at nine o'clock.

vocabulary.example: Last Saturday, my family and I went to the beach.
First, we drove to the beach.
After that, we parked the car and walked to the sand.
We put our things on the sand and went swimming.
Then we had a picnic lunch.
After that, we played volleyball on the beach.

grammar.title: 一般过去时与顺序词
grammar.explanation: 一般过去时用来描述过去发生的动作或状态。规则动词的过去式通常在词尾加-ed，如 parked, played, watched；不规则动词的过去式需要单独记忆，如 went, drove, ate, had, took。顺序词 then, after that, finally 用来表示事情发生的先后顺序。
grammar.example: First, we drove to the beach. After that, we parked the car and walked to the sand. Finally, we watched the sunset.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: Yesterday, I ___ to the park.
questions.explanation: go 的过去式是 went，不规则变化。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: She ___ a beautiful bird in the tree.
questions.explanation: see 的过去式是 saw，不规则变化。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We had lunch. ___, we went shopping.
questions.explanation: Then 表示“然后”，用于描述下一个动作。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: They ___ dinner at a restaurant last night.
questions.explanation: have 的过去式是 had，不规则变化。
